construction_notes.covariate_shift: Resamples REAL test rows with weight proportional to exp(alpha * z), so P(X) changes while P(Y|X) is preserved EXACTLY — no feature values are edited and no label mechanism is touched.
construction_notes.label_shift: Resamples positives and negatives at different rates to move P(Y) by the given amount while preserving P(X|Y) exactly.
construction_notes.concept_shift: Flips the label mechanism inside a fixed subgroup, swapping equal counts of 0->1 and 1->0 so P(X) is preserved exactly and marginal P(Y) is held approximately constant — isolating P(Y|X) change from label shift.
